scope: One analog observer channel; no control output or permanent harness
filter: EWMA alpha=1/4 on raw ADC counts; millivolts estimated from same unfiltered sample
rc_limitation: Calculation excludes joystick source impedance and ADC loading; this is not power-off isolation or overvoltage protection
gamepad_supply: Original battery only; original charging USB disconnected
signal_connection_order: Ground first with both boards off; power and check both independently; signal last while both are powered
signal_disconnection_order: Disconnect signal before any reset, upload, power loss, shutdown or cable change; remove ground last

phases.name: Review model and physical pin
phases.exit: Pin label/availability, parts, independent supplies, recovery, build and no-drive policy checked

phases.name: S3-only reference
phases.exit: With gamepad disconnected, ground reference and optional DMM-verified midpoint respond correctly; timeout/stop and UI health checked

phases.name: Gamepad alone
phases.exit: Record battery-only L-X min/center/max, startup/timeout rail behavior and independent ground references; no S3 connection

phases.name: Supervised L-X observer
phases.exit: Record repeated extrema/center, DMM comparison and loading; no resets/stale samples; signal removed before power changes

phases.name: Permanent electrical design
phases.exit: Power-off-safe interface and power-state matrix qualified; exact button topology, connector views and pin mapping reviewed

phases.name: Mechanical fit
phases.exit: Actual outline, hole centers, heights, datums, module locations and ribbon reach measured and native assembly checked

phases.name: Control transport
phases.exit: Receiver failsafe, arming, stale/duplicate handling, timeout and deadman tested before actuator commands

mechanical_limitation: Measured bounding envelope only; actual contour and hole locations unknown
